name: Ata’mal Crystal — Spirit’s Song
shortDescription: Ata’mal Crystal — Spirit’s Song, represented in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: The crystal recovered from Culuthas, later named Spirit’s Song by A’dal. Shape and glow are interpretive, not canonical item-model evidence. This is original interpretive art, not a canonical item model or source of undocumented physical properties. Compare it with the original Burning Crusade client/model before human review. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
